migrations.description: Separate immutable data_excel versions, native facts, query projections and effects
statements:
CREATE TABLE sheet_source(source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, logical_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_path TEXT, origin TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_version(snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_source(source_id),
            generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0), previous_snapshot TEXT REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            manifest_object TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objects(digest), raw_object TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objects(digest),
            facts_object TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objects(digest), parser_contract TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(source_id,generation)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_current(source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sheet_source(source_id),
            snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_cell_sample(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_chart_metadata(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_defined_name(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_formula(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_hyperlink(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_range(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_relationship(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_tab(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_table(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_validation(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_workbook(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, part TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,item_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_chunk(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            chunk_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
            text_object TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objects(digest), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,chunk_id)) STRICT
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE sheet_chunk_fts USING fts5(snapshot_id UNINDEXED,chunk_id UNINDEXED,text_content,tokenize=unicode61)

CREATE TABLE sheet_export(export_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            destination TEXT NOT NULL, before_sha256 TEXT, after_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, effect_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE sheet_derivative(derivative_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sheet_version(snapshot_id),
            kind TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_object TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objects(digest), created_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE INDEX sheet_versions_source ON sheet_version(source_id,generation)

migrations.description: Retain source retirement proofs without deleting lineage heads
statements:
CREATE TABLE selector_retirement(
            snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES objects(digest),
            proof_object TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objects(digest),
            job_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
